CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Indicates the overall priority of this account based on weighted factors. How this score is calculated: • Whitespace: 80% Intent Score | 20% News • Free Orgs / Free Workspaces: 40% Intent | 40% Expansion | 20% News • Paid Orgs / Paid Workspaces: 100% Expansion Score
For details on how Expansion Score is calculated, visit go/xqa.
CustomField.label: Account Priority Score
